structures.name: Right Atrium
structures.description: Receives deoxygenated systemic venous return from SVC and IVC.

structures.name: Right Ventricle
structures.description: Pumps deoxygenated blood into pulmonary trunk.

structures.name: Left Atrium
structures.description: Receives oxygenated pulmonary return from lungs.

structures.name: Left Ventricle
structures.description: Pumps oxygenated blood into systemic arterial circulation.

structures.name: Ascending Aorta
structures.description: Primary high-pressure trunk from Left Ventricle.

structures.name: Aortic Arch
structures.description: Curved arch giving rise to brachiocephalic, carotid, and subclavian arteries.

structures.name: Superior Vena Cava
structures.description: Drains upper body venous return into Right Atrium.

structures.name: Inferior Vena Cava
structures.description: Drains lower body venous return into Right Atrium.

structures.name: Left Femoral Artery
structures.description: Major left thigh arterial trunk following femur.

structures.name: Right Femoral Artery
structures.description: Major right thigh arterial trunk following femur.
